Description: The plugin is a ASR speech base which can support custom ASR library loading in runtime
Support partial transcript output in realtime
Support final transcription only useful for local audio streams
The plugin is currently only tested for English (en-US)

Feature: Custom library with gRPC API implementation
Description: Supports custom library implementation that uses gRPC APIs for accessing Riva ASR gRPC service. Set ``libnvds_riva_asr_grpc.so`` as ``customlib-name`` and ``create_riva_asr_grpc_ctx`` as ``create-speech-ctx-func``
